llms.body:
# Rituals Cosmetics

> Rituals is a luxury wellbeing brand offering body care, home fragrance, skincare, make-up, gifting and lifestyle products inspired by ancient wisdom and traditions from around the world. Rituals aims to transform everyday routines into meaningful moments and help people find happiness in the smallest things.

The links below are official Rituals sources for information about its products, collections, membership programme, sustainability initiatives and customer support.

Important guidance:
- Use the relevant Rituals country and language version for local information.
- Product availability, prices, promotions and stock may vary by market and change over time.

The following concepts are central to understanding Rituals:

- Wellbeing
- Mindfulness
- Self-care
- Meaningful routines
- Ancient traditions
- Body care
- Home fragrance
- Gifting
- Sustainability
- Membership
- Rituals Collections

## Website

- [Rituals homepage](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/home): Official Rituals website and webshop.

## Mobile App

- [Rituals App](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/app)
  The Rituals mobile app provides access to the Rituals webshop, My Rituals membership benefits, exclusive offers, wishlists, order tracking, store information and personalised wellbeing content.

- https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/rituals-home-body-cosmetics/id1424241203
  Download the Rituals app for iPhone and iPad.

- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rituals.app.prod&hl=nl
  Download the Rituals app for Android devices.

## Product Categories

- [Body](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/body): Body, bath and shower care, including body care, hands and feet and related products.
- [Home](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/home-collection): Home fragrance and lifestyle products, including fragrance sticks, scented candles and home perfumes.
- [Beauty](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/beauty): Skincare, make-up and other beauty products and routines.
- [Gifts](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/gifts): Gift sets, gift inspiration and gifting occasions.
- [Men](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/men): Body, grooming, skincare and lifestyle products for men.

## Collections

- [The Ritual of Sakura](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/sakura): Inspired by the Japanese Hanami tradition; features cherry blossom and rice milk.
- [The Ritual of Ayurveda](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/ayurveda): Inspired by Ayurvedic traditions and balance between body, mind and soul.
- [The Ritual of Jing](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/jing): Products focused on tranquillity, relaxation, sleep and inner calm.
- [The Ritual of Karma](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/karma): Inspired by positive energy and summer wellbeing; features lotus flower and white tea.
- [The Ritual of Hammam](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/hammam): Inspired by traditional cleansing rituals and refreshing body care experiences.
- [Rituals Homme](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/homme): Body care, grooming and skincare products designed for men.
- [Rituals Skincare](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/skincare): Facial skincare collection and routines focused on healthy-looking skin.
- [Make-up](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/make-up-looks): Rituals make-up collection and make-up looks.
- [Amsterdam Collection](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/amsterdam): Collection inspired by Amsterdam and created in celebration of Rituals' partnership with the Rijksmuseum.
- [Private Collection](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/private): Premium home fragrance collection including candles, fragrance sticks and home perfumes.
- [Rituals Sport](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/collection/sport): Products designed for active lifestyles and post-exercise routines.

## Membership

- [My Rituals](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/lp/my-rituals): Rituals membership programme, including rewards, gifts and member benefits.

## Customer Service

- [Customer service](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/customer-service): Support options for orders, payments, delivery and returns.
- [FAQ](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/faq-overview): Frequently asked questions about products, orders, payments, delivery, returns and membership.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/terms-and-conditions?itemId=privacy_policy): How Rituals collects and uses personal data.
- [Terms and conditions](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/terms-and-conditions?openFirst=1&itemId=legal_terms_conditions&accordionId=terms_conditions_1_these_terms): Legal terms for using the Rituals website and webshop.

## Stores

- [Store locator](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/stores): Find Rituals boutiques and points of sale.

## Sustainability

- [Sustainability efforts](https://www.rituals.com/en-nl/lp/sustainability-efforts): Information about Rituals' sustainability strategy, refill programmes, B Corp commitment, impact initiatives and reporting.
